q1.explanationZh: 女孩说上学穿的鞋已经买了，只需要一件外套（I just need a coat），就在这家店买。A 错：鞋已经买过了；C 错：数学书在网上买更便宜，爸爸也同意了。

q2.explanationZh: 男孩平时周六上午在公园踢足球，但这周朋友们有别的事，他就改去了游泳池（go to the pool instead）。A 错：电影院是他下午要去的地方；C 错：这周他没去踢足球。

q3.explanationZh: 男孩以为 Amelia 戴眼镜、留金色长发，女孩说头发长度说对了，但颜色其实很深，而且从没见她戴过眼镜。所以她是长黑发、不戴眼镜。B、C 错：她不戴眼镜，C 的头发颜色也不对。

q4.explanationZh: 妈妈说蔬菜她已经切好了，请男孩把刀叉等餐具摆到桌上（putting all the knives and forks and things on the table），男孩答应了。A 错：蔬菜妈妈已经切好了；B 错：去超市的是妈妈。

q5.explanationZh: 女孩说她们常去海边的小村子，但这次大家想换换，于是去了山里（went up into the mountains instead）。A 错：她们是离开城市出去玩；C 错：海边小村是她们平时常去的地方。

q6.explanationZh: 老师说新的借书证在前台（front desk）领取。information 不对：前台在咨询台（information desk）的对面。

q7.explanationZh: 图书馆每天早 8 点到晚 6 点开放，周二和周四开到 7:45，所以周二 7:45 关门。8 a.m. 和 6 p.m. 是其他日子的开放时间。

q8.explanationZh: 新的图书馆经理是 Mrs Carter，老师还把名字拼了出来：C-A-R-T-E-R，一定要拼写正确。

q9.explanationZh: 老师说学校里任何地方都不能用手机，但可以带自己的平板电脑（tablet）到图书馆做项目作业。phones 不对。

q10.explanationZh: 图书馆每月都有不同主题的展览，第一个是关于时尚（fashion）的。history 只是举例，不是第一个展览的主题。

q11.explanationZh: Lily 说她起晚了没吃早饭，一直在想吃的（couldn’t stop thinking about food），说明她很饿。A 错：她没说累；B 错：她觉得博物馆还可以（it was OK），并不无聊。

q12.explanationZh: Johnny 很高兴老师为这次出行订了大巴（book a bus），所以他们是坐大巴去的。B、C 错：从火车站一路走过去的是他妹妹的班级。

q13.explanationZh: Lily 说她最喜欢了解人为什么会生病、医生怎样帮助病人，也就是健康方面的知识。A 错：月亮和星星的内容只是“有意思”；B 错：关于电的知识她早就知道了。

q14.explanationZh: Johnny 说他决定买一个游戏（get a game），因为他更喜欢游戏。A 错：他没买那本书；C 错：图画很好，但他钱不够。

q15.explanationZh: Lily 希望下次去乡下，了解粮食怎样种植、动物怎样饲养，也就是去农场。A 错：她说 Art’s not for me（艺术不适合我）；B 错：她觉得去农场比参观古堡更有趣。

q16.explanationZh: Gemma 说下车时曲棍球棒从运动包里掉出来砸到了脚，很疼，没法跑，所以她受伤了。B 错：她已经看完牙医回来了；C 错：她带着运动包，没有忘带装备。

q17.explanationZh: 男孩说上周他用英语写了一篇 500 词的故事，还得了奖。A 错：赛跑第一只是故事内容，并不是真的；C 错：参演学校戏剧是姑姑的建议。

q18.explanationZh: 女孩说那里的曲奇最好吃，男孩同意，还说蛋糕也好吃，所以他们喜欢那里好吃的东西。A 错：男孩说学校里没多少人去那儿；B 错：女孩说那里有点贵。

q19.explanationZh: 女孩去滑雪，说整周阳光都很强，出门都得戴太阳镜；最后两晚还下了将近一米的雪，所以天气又冷又晴。A 错：只有最后两晚下了雪；B 错：天天阴天的是她家这里。

q20.explanationZh: 她们约好在电影院外见面：一个中午搭妈妈的车，另一个的公交车中午前到，于是约在十二点一刻（quarter past）见，所以是在商量见面时间。B 错：只有一人提到想去的服装店；C 错：她们说的是怎么去，不是之后怎么回家。

q21.explanationZh: 女孩说 Alex 去年在橄榄球队，但今天足球队需要人，所以他踢足球（football）。D 错：rugby 是去年的事。

q22.explanationZh: John 本来想打网球，但人太多，所以改打曲棍球（playing hockey instead）。G 错：网球他没打成。

q23.explanationZh: 女孩说会在游泳池看到 Sally（We will see her in the pool!），所以她参加游泳。B 错：football 只是说明游泳比赛在足球之后。

q24.explanationZh: Ben 去年棒球打得很好，但今年年初开始练跑步，要参加 100 米比赛，所以是 running。A 错：棒球是过去的事。

q25.explanationZh: Mary 说她刚买了新球拍，很想第一次用它，而且不想再打曲棍球了，所以她打网球（tennis）。C 错：hockey 是她不想再参加的项目。

content.v: Test Four. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. What do they want to buy in the department store?
This looks like a good shop. We could get that maths book you need for school here.
I’m sure it’ll be cheaper on the internet, Dad.
Yes, you’re right. So have we got everything then?
We’ve already bought some school shoes so I just need a coat. Let’s get that here.
OK.
Two. Where did the boy go this morning?
Hi, where have you been? You look tired.
I usually play football in the park on Saturday mornings, but my friends were doing other things this week so I decided to go to the pool instead.
Are you going home now?
Yes, for lunch. Then I’m meeting a group of friends at the cinema later on. Why don’t you come too?
Thanks!
Three. Who is the girl going to meet?
Are you going out?
Yes, I’m meeting my friend Amelia – she’s just started at our school.
Oh, is she the girl with glasses and long blonde hair?
You got the length right but it’s actually quite dark. I’ve never seen her wearing glasses.
Oh yes, I know who she is now. Well, have a good time.
Four. How will the boy help his mum?
Is dinner nearly ready, Mum?
No, and I need to go to the supermarket because we haven’t got any milk.
Oh no. Well, why don’t I cut some vegetables while you go there?
That’s really kind of you, but I’ve already done it. How about putting all the knives and forks and things on the table?
OK, no problem.
Five. Where did the girl spend the day with her family?
Did you have a good day yesterday?
Yes, I went out with my family. It was great to spend some time away from the city!
Sounds nice.
It was. We often go to this little village by the sea where there’s a nice beach, but we all wanted a change, so we went up into the mountains instead.
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher telling her class about some changes to the school library.
Good morning everyone. I’d like to tell you about some changes to the school library. You can now borrow books not for two weeks, but for three.
You will need a new library card, which is available at the front desk, which you’ll see when you enter the library. It’s opposite the information desk.
The library will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day and until 7:45 on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
We have a new manager working in the library, Mrs Carter. I’ll spell her name for you. C-A-R-T-E-R. You might need to email her for advice.
There are quiet areas where you can do your homework. Please remember you can’t use phones anywhere in the school, but you can bring your tablet to do project work in the library.
There will be a different exhibition in the library every month, on subjects such as history. And we’ll start with a really interesting one about fashion. Has anybody got any questions?
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear Johnny talking to his friend Lily about a school trip to a museum that they went on.
Hi Lily, did you enjoy the school trip?
Hi Johnny. I thought the science museum might not be interesting, but it was OK. Except I woke up late and didn’t have time for breakfast – I couldn’t stop thinking about food!
I’m glad our teacher decided to book a bus for the trip. My sister’s class had to walk all the way from the train station. What did you enjoy most?
The information about the moon and stars was interesting, but my favourite was finding out why people get ill and how doctors help them. I knew that stuff about electricity already.
The museum shop had some great pictures, but I didn’t have enough money.
Did you get that book you were looking at?
I decided to get a game because I enjoy those more.
I can’t wait for the next trip. I hope we go to the countryside to find out how our food’s grown and how the animals are looked after. It’s more interesting than visiting an old castle or something.
I’d prefer to see some famous paintings.
Art’s not for me.
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear a teacher talking to a student called Gemma. Why can’t Gemma play hockey today?
Ah Gemma, you’re back from the dentist’s. I hope you’re playing in this afternoon’s hockey match.
I’m really sorry I can’t. After seeing the dentist, when I was getting out of my mum’s car my hockey stick fell out of my sports bag and hit my foot.
Oh dear.
It’s really painful and I can’t run.
I’m sorry to hear that.
Seventeen. You will hear a boy talking to his aunt about school. What did he do at school last week?
How’s school, Sam?
It’s great! I won a prize last week, for a 500-word story I did in English. It was about coming first in a running race. It wasn’t true. I don’t even like sport!
Wow! Have you ever considered getting a part in the school play?
No. But I might try.
Eighteen. You will hear two friends talking about a café. Why do they like going there?
I really like going to Toni’s Café.
So do I. It’s a good place to do homework after school. You can always get a table. And the cookies are the best.
True. And the cakes. I’m surprised that not many other people from school hang out there.
I guess it is a bit expensive.
Nineteen. You will hear a girl telling a friend about her holiday. What was the weather like on her holiday?
How was your skiing trip?
Fantastic! It was so bright all week that I had to wear sunglasses whenever I went outside. It’s hard being back here – grey clouds, day after day.
But it’s warmer here.
True. I don’t need so many clothes! There wasn’t much snow when we got there. Then the last two nights, nearly a metre fell.
Twenty. You will hear two friends talking about going shopping. What are they deciding?
You know we’re meeting outside the cinema to go shopping tomorrow?
Yes. I’m looking forward to going to that new clothes shop opposite the department store. I’m still getting a lift with Mum – she’s fetching my brother from the train station at midday.
Perfect. My bus arrives just before then. So see you at quarter past.
Sure.
That is the end of Part Four.
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear two friends talking about a school sports day. What sport will each person do?
It’s great that our classmates are doing so many different sports today!
Yeah, Anne’s done a lot of swimming this term. Is she doing that today?
Actually, she’s playing volleyball today.
And what’s Alex doing?
Last year he was in a rugby team, but today they needed someone for the football team, so he’ll do that because he’s a good runner. Do you know what John’s doing?
He wanted to do tennis, but there were too many people, so he’s playing hockey instead. What about Sally?
We will see her in the pool! That’s at two o’clock, just after the football. Is Ben playing baseball? He was really good last year.
He was, but he started running at the beginning of the year. He’s doing the 100 metres. What about you, Mary?
I’ve just got a new racket, so I’m excited to use it for the first time. I’m glad about that because I didn’t want to do hockey again!
It’s going to be great!
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
